content:
**Top 5 Largest Banks in the World (2024‑2025) by Market Capitalisation**

| Rank | Bank (Legal name) | Approx. Market‑Cap* (US $ billion) | Headquarters | Main corporate website |
|------|-------------------|-----------------------------------|--------------|------------------------|
| **1** | **JPMorgan Chase & Co.** | **≈ $470 billion** | New York, USA | <https://www.jpmorganchase.com> |
| **2** | **Bank of America Corp.** | **≈ $280 billion** | Charlotte, USA | <https://www.bankofamerica.com> |
| **3** | **Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Ltd. (ICBC)** | **≈ $200 billion** | Beijing, China | <https://www.icbc.com.cn> |
| **4** | **China Construction Bank Corp. (CCB)** | **≈ $170 billion** | Beijing, China | <https://www.ccb.com> |
| **5** | **Agricultural Bank of China Ltd. (ABC)** | **≈ $150 billion** | Beijing, China | <https://www.abchina.com> |

\* *Market‑capitalisation figures are round‑numbers taken from the latest publicly‑available data (mid‑2024 to early‑2025) on major financial‑data platforms (Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Reuters). They reflect the total value of each bank’s listed shares at that time and are subject to daily market fluctuations.*

### How the list was compiled
1. **Screened all globally listed banks** (those with shares traded on major exchanges) for their latest market‑cap.  
2. **Sorted** the banks in descending order of market‑cap.  
3. **Selected the top five** – two U.S. banks and three Chinese “Big Four” state‑owned commercial banks, which consistently dominate the global ranking by market value.  

### Quick links to each bank’s investor‑relations page (where the market‑cap numbers are regularly updated)

| Bank | Investor‑Relations / Market‑Cap page |
|------|--------------------------------------|
| JPMorgan Chase & Co. | <https://investor.jpmorganchase.com> |
| Bank of America Corp. | <https://investor.bankofamerica.com> |
| ICBC | <https://www.icbc.com.cn/ICBC/%E5%9C%8B%E9%9A%9B%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B6%E5%8F%8A%E5%88%86%E4%BA%AB%E5%8D%80> (English version: <https://global.icbc.com>) |
| China Construction Bank | <https://www.ccb.com/en/investor/> |
| Agricultural Bank of China | <https://www.abchina.com/en/InvestorRelations/> |

### Why market‑cap matters (vs. assets)
* **Market‑cap** reflects the market’s valuation of a bank’s equity, incorporating profitability, growth prospects, risk profile and investor sentiment.  
* **Total assets** (often used in “largest‑by‑assets” lists) can be massive for state‑owned lenders, but market‑cap better captures how the financial community values the institution today.

---

**Bottom line:** As of 2024‑2025, the global banking landscape by market value is led by JPMorgan Chase, followed by Bank of America, and then the three biggest Chinese commercial banks (ICBC, China Construction Bank, Agricultural Bank of China). Their official web‑sites (linked above) provide the most reliable source for up‑to‑date corporate and financial information.
